description: This course explores Harlem, NY, focusing on the Harlem Renaissance, a major cultural movement from
the 1920s and 1930s. In January, students attend music performances, cultural events, and site
visits. These activities aim to deepen their understanding of this significant era through
readings, guest lectures, archival research, and exploration. Students reflect on how, despite
challenges related to power, class, race, and gender, the movement promoted progress in arts,
ideas, and social change. Offered periodically during January term.
fullname: New York Music Immersion: Harlem Renaissance Connections (study away)
